_comment: Checks that are KNOWN to fail right now, with the reason and the condition that
clears them. A baselined check still shows as FAIL in the report and in the pull
request comment — this file never changes what is reported, only whether CI treats
the run as a REGRESSION. The gate asks 'did this change break something new', which
is a question a red baseline can still answer.
Every entry needs a 'clears_when'. A baseline without an exit condition is just a
disabled check, and the pipeline warns when a baselined check starts passing so the
entry gets deleted instead of quietly becoming a permanent blind spot.

A07.reason: The deployed operator predates the killSwitch stamp on model.Decision / audit.Record / runner.processTenant, so a kill-switched decision is byte-identical in the audit to one whose actuator failed. The source fix is in this repo; the running binary is older.
A07.clears_when: the first merge to main that rebuilds the operator image is rolled out by ArgoCD

A05.reason: The deployed console (0.4.4) predates voice being added to armedWorkloads, so it answers the attack POST with 'namespace not armed for live attack: voice' and no decision can change. Confirmed from attackResponse in the run JSON, not inferred from the absence of a reaction.
A05.clears_when: the first merge to main that rebuilds the console image is rolled out by ArgoCD
